name: LIP! Lewd Idol Project Vol. 3 - Hot Springs and Beach Episodes
detailed_description:
The ultimate fanservice experience is back for the last time!

A 2-in-1 yuri lewd adventure for the cultured people!

Let’s go!


Important: This release contains two fanservice episodes that complement the main story of LIP! Lewd Idol Project and take place after Vol. 3. Both episodes can be enjoyed without any prior knowledge of the series, but be sure to check out the main story for the complete experience!



LIP! Lewd Idol Project is a yuri Visual Novel series about a girl's adventure to becoming an Akihabara Lewd Idol!

Join Kairi in her adventure and explore the city, meet new girls, and try to form a group overcoming all the odds while having a lot of girl-on-girl action!

Make sure to grab our Lewd Idol Project Bundle with special discounts if you don’t own the previous installments!



After the group is finally complete and the girls are enjoying well-deserved popularity both in Akihabara and on the internet, maintaining success becomes quite a challenge and time to rest is increasingly scarce... But that won't stop our favorite lewd idols from having their time to relax!

“Relaxing time is as important as hard work... Especially when you're surrounded by such young and beautiful girls!”
Ranko. Lewd Idol Project member and producer.

The newest member of the group, Kanako-chan, receives a mysterious letter from the town where she grew up when she was just a child... Apparently, an old hot springs inn now belongs to her. Kairi and the others are more than excited about this unexpected news but…
Is everything really as great as it seems?

Kanako is as surprised as she is worried about this situation, so the group decides to embark on a journey to visit this mysterious residence and uncover the truth.

A haunted inn? Unsolved mysteries? Pervy ghosts?
Discover all this and more in our last Hot Springs Episode!

PLOT Queen, the hottest contest of the summer, is back and for this edition, the now-legendary inaugural winner Kairi-chan is the most sought-after girl to make her triumphant return to the beach stage. But this time she won't be alone…

The whole band is set to please the audience with a special live show!
However, the tensions between Kanako and Yuki are hotter than ever and Kairi no longer knows what to do to stop them from fighting over her…

Will this contest be the perfect opportunity to settle everything and decide who the winner is?
Hot swimsuits, a fierce love competition, a brand new live show and much more in our final Beach Episode!

Let’s rock!













• High quality anime-style artwork
• Fully uncensored yuri 18+ CGs
• Multiple Endings
• Relationship Meter between the girls
• Unlockable CG Gallery to view erotic scenes
• Wardrobe Mode with many alternative costumes to unlock
• Photo Mode
• Jukebox Mode
• Partial Japanese voice acting


Hot Springs or Beach? Which one are you gonna play first?


Unlock and enjoy both wholesome and erotic yuri CG scenes in Gallery Mode!


Kairi, Kanako, Yuki and Ranko will have unlockable sets of sexy swimsuits, yukata, and towels to enjoy.
Play both episodes and get them all!


After getting a new costume, you'll get unlimited access to them in Wardrobe Mode.
Try to unlock them all!


Our heroines will have a relationship meter that will increase or decrease each time you take an action or dialogue decision while interacting with each other.
Build your meters up to 100% and unlock extra scenes, dialogues, and endings!


Discover and unlock up to four different endings depending on your choices!


Create your own scene with your favorite girls and costumes and take a picture to save on your device!
